sentences.en: Some people think that hang gliding is a dangerous sport.
sentences.zh: 有些人认为滑翔伞是一项危险的运动。

sentences.en: A bird can glide through the air without moving its wings.
sentences.zh: 鸟儿可以在空中滑翔而不需要拍打翅膀。

sentences.en: Look how the plane is gliding toward the field!
sentences.zh: 看那架飞机如何平稳地向田地降落！

senses.zh: 滑翔；滑行；悄悄地走；消逝
